entry_point: sh loopctl/loopctl.sh skill-execution run --request <request> --assertions <assertions> --repo <subject checkout> --output <receipt dir>
credential_channel: The runner refuses credential-shaped environment names outright. The agent CLI authenticates from the host's own login state reached through HOME; no API key is passed into the request, and only environment variable names -- never values -- appear in it.
skill_delivery: canonical-path-in-worktree: this executor installs nothing into .claude/skills, so the exported prompt names the Skill's canonical path inside the disposable worktree. That is a real difference from skill-up's install-and-autodiscover delivery and must not be averaged away.
artifact_retention: The disposable worktree is destroyed on exit (cleanup=required), so produced artifacts survive only as blobs the file_content assertions copy into the receipt's content-addressed store before cleanup.
